title: FlatRestrictionExactLeftAdjoint
statement: For a small site K and a morphism a from a sheaf of commutative rings R to such a sheaf S, assume the restricted unit S is flat in the sense of [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. There exists an additive functor E from Mod(R) to Mod(S) [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] preserving finite limits, together with an adjunction having E as left adjoint to the actual scalar-restriction functor r [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars].

proof.text: Construct the sheafified scalar-extension functor. Sectionwise scalar extension and restriction have the natural Hom bijection f↦(m↦f(1 tensor m)), with inverse g↦(s tensor m↦s g(m)). These maps commute with site restrictions. Module sheafification extends the bijection to sheaves, giving the adjunction and additivity.

Compare the underlying abelian presheaf of scalar extension with the sectionwise tensor of M and the restricted unit S by tensor symmetry. The pure-tensor formula gives naturality in site restrictions and in M. Whisker this natural isomorphism with abelian sheafification. It identifies E followed by the underlying abelian-sheaf functor with siteSheafTensorRight of the restricted unit, followed by the same forgetful functor. Flatness implies that this composite preserves finite limits. The faithful underlying-sheaf functor reflects finite limits, so E does also. Its adjunction supplies zero preservation; finite-limit preservation then gives additivity. The complete construction is proved in Lean.

mathlib_searches.query: Flat scalar restriction for sheaves of modules has an exact left adjoint and derived coefficient comparisons are mates
mathlib_searches.verdict: The results provide ordinary scalar restriction and module scalar-extension adjunctions, but no normalized sheaf-diagram comparison or exact sheaf scalar extension matching this statement.

mathlib_searches.query: An exact scalar extension left adjoint to restriction of sheaves of modules when the coefficient algebra is flat
mathlib_searches.verdict: Found scalar-extension adjunctions for modules and geometric pullback. No exact left adjoint for this sheaf coefficient restriction is supplied directly.
Matches give change-of-rings exactness for ordinary modules and restriction for presheaves. The sheafified scalar-extension construction and its flatness comparison must be proved.

from.place: proof steps 2-3: exact scalar extension left adjoint to restriction

lean.statement:
theorem flatRestriction_exact_leftAdjoint
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {K : GrothendieckTopology C}
    {R S : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u}} (a : R ⟶ S)
    (hflat : IsFlatOnSite.{u, u, u, u}
      ((restrictScalars.{u} ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map a)).obj
        (unit.{u} ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S)))) :
    ∃ E : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S),
      E.Additive ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits E ∧
        Nonempty (E ⊣ restrictScalars.{u}
          ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map a))
